description:
Who is One Laser?

America is experiencing a manufacturing renaissance, and One Laser is here to meet the demand for high-quality, reliable laser engraving products. Unlike others in the industry, we prioritize community, quality, and true US-based support, ensuring our customers can achieve their dreams without compromise. From the craftsmanship of our machines to our commitment to innovation, we’re here to help you reach your goals and dream bigger.

What is X-Series?

1. Powerful Engraving Options:

• XRF: High-speed, 3D photorealistic engraving with a 38w RF tube.

• XT: Efficient crafting powered by a robust 55w DC Glass Tube.

2. Unmatched Speed and Productivity:

• True 3G Acceleration (29,430mm/s²) for unparalleled performance.

• Speeds up to 800mm/s (XT) and 1200mm/s (XRF), powered by optimized DSP motion control for reduced work time and cost.

3. Generous Workspace:

• 23.6” x 11.8” (600mm x 300mm) bed size, ideal for tackling projects of any size.

4. FumeGuard™ Technology:

• Industry-first FumeWatch System designed to control harmful fumes, ensuring safety for your home, children, and pets.

5. The Fastest in Its Class Worldwide:

• Outperforms traditional G-code-powered diode and CO2 machines, providing superior engraving speeds and long-term reliability without the need for future upgrades.

6. Designed for Versatility and Quality:

• High-speed and precision engraving with options tailored for both creative crafting and industrial-level productivity.


Payment terms:
Monthly Payments via Paypal, Zelle, or Wire Transfer.

Welcome to OneLaser! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Each affiliate is provided with a unique referral link. This link can be used to promote the OneLaser website or specific product pages and collections. If a user clicks on multiple referral links, the most recent link clicked will be credited for the sale.

Affiliates may be assigned a custom coupon code for promotional purposes. If you are not assigned a branded or personal coupon code, you are not authorized to promote or share any OneLaser discount codes, including those found online or through other affiliates. If a customer both: Clicks your referral link and uses your assigned coupon code during checkout, you will earn only one commission, not a double reward.

Posting your coupon code or referral link on deal aggregation sites, browser extensions, or coupon-sharing platforms (e.g. Honey, RetailMeNot, Slickdeals, etc.) is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate termination from the affiliate program. Affiliates may promote their link or coupon code through: Social media platforms (e.g. Instagram, Facebook, YouTube), personal blogs or websites, email newsletters, offline media such as magazines, newspapers, or local ads. All promotions must comply with our brand guidelines and FTC disclosure requirements.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: marketing@1laser.com


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document. We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to marketing@1laser.com for support.
